import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from src.greeting import greeting

try:
    config = json.loads(Path("config/app.json").read_text())
except (OSError, ValueError):
    print("Lantern configuration is unavailable.", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print(greeting(config["audience"]))
